original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚贝努埃州发生新袭击，一名神职人员及另外三人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据称，疑似武装牧民对尼日利亚贝努埃州Logo地方政府区Gaambe-Tiev Ward的Abeda Shitile社区发动新的袭击，造成至少四人死亡，其中包括一名神职人员，另有八人受伤。一名当地居民称，袭击者于当天下午5时左右在市场商贩和居民准备离开时闯入，现场传出密集枪声。上述伤亡与袭击者身份尚未获得独立确认，目前仅有一个来源报道。

location.site: Logo地方政府区Gaambe-Tiev Ward的Abeda Shitile社区
location.raw_text: Abeda Shitile community in Gaambe-Tiev Ward, Logo Local Government Area of Benue State

key_facts.fact: 据称至少四人死亡，其中包括一名神职人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least four persons, including a clergyman, have reportedly been killed in a fresh attack by suspected armed herders

key_facts.fact: 另有八人在袭击中受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Eight others were also reportedly injured in the attack, which occurred on Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: 袭击地点为贝努埃州Logo地方政府区Gaambe-Tiev Ward的Abeda Shitile社区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: on Abeda Shitile community in Gaambe-Tiev Ward, Logo Local Government Area of Benue State

key_facts.fact: 一名居民称袭击者约在下午5时市场人员准备离开时发动袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attack, suspected to have been carried out by armed herders, started around 5pm when traders and other residents were preparing to leave the market.

uncertainties: 袭击者身份仅为疑似武装牧民，尚未证实
伤亡数字据称，尚未获得独立确认
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，缺乏交叉验证
